answer: One island holds all onyx and issues a fixed dawn stock, one dawn per incumbent, halved each epoch with no new mint. Every onyx must hold one dawn, re-bought at renewal from that shrinking stock. A thousand clones must bid a thousand dawn away from incumbents, so each additional clone raises the clearing price and the marginal clone pays it; the island does not shard and renewal is atomic, so parallel bids cannot mint extra dawn. The bill is capital paid for decaying dawn, attached to each onyx renewal. It breaks if dawn is minted or renewal runs off-chain.
